column1: # Tone-of-typing TRAINING corpus — label <TAB> lang <TAB> text.
# Methodology (and honest limits): a hand-authored seed set for a COARSE mood
# hint, written for this feature (2026-07) in the style of short terminal /
# chat lines. Five classes (calm / excited / frustrated / playful /
# technical), ~60 lines per class, spanning en zh ja ko es de fr ru ar hi
# plus code-flavoured technical lines. Lines were written to carry each
# mood's LOUD SURFACE MARKERS (laughter tokens, exclamation shapes,
# complaint vocabulary, shell/code syntax) because that is exactly what a
# hashed char-n-gram model can learn from a set this small. This is NOT a
# sentiment-science dataset: no sarcasm, no dialect breadth, no annotation
# process beyond the author's judgement; machine assistance was used to
# draft and review the non-English lines (same curation stance as the
# lexicon's seed data: best-effort, extend via PR). The committed holdout
# file is the conformance expectations set, held out from SGD.
